name: hud_ui_clamped_int_text_input_constructor
description: HudUiClampedIntTextInput construction and input-method contract for the clamped integer widget. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: VC COFF byte target covers the clamped input methods; the constructor at 0x41a200 still has byte drift from base-constructor/vptr scheduling.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x41a200 validates BaseConstructor(), temporary base constructor dispatch table installation by the compiler, text buffer allocation from maxDigits + 1, Update(""), SetInputActive(0), final derived class dispatch table installation, and the full signed int32 clamp range.

Binary Ninja evidence for the constructor dispatch table validates slot 33 as HudUiClampedIntTextInput::OnRawKeyboardChar, slot 34 as HudUiNumericTextInput::OnAcceptForwardToCommit, and slot 35 as HudUiClampedIntTextInput::CommitAndGetValue.

The native smoke verifies constructor state, derived class method wiring, digit-only raw keyboard filtering, accept forwarding through the commit method, and clamp/writeback behavior for empty and out-of-range text.
